messages:
anya: Heads-up — saw a spike in unassigned inbound leads from EMEA last night. Many have enrichment pending > 15m. hs-sync-bot logged 502s to SF webhook.
sam: Ugh. Did we change enrichment TTL? I thought default was 10m.
devin: We bumped TTL to 30m in the enrichment lambda for batched jobs last week to reduce token calls; forgot to update HubSpot handoff rule.
anya: Can we do a temporary fallback: if enrichment takes >10m, assign to 'inbound-default-queue' and add tag 'enrich-deferred'?
nicole: +1. That keeps SDRs from losing leads and keeps SLA intact.
hs-sync-bot: webhook_error: POST /salesforce/handoff 502 (payload_id=af34xyz123)
sam: I'll open quick patch for HubSpot workflow: add Branch: IF enrichment_status != 'complete' AND now() - created_at > 600 THEN set owner = 'inbound-default-queue'
sam: Quick SQL to find affected leads:
```
SELECT id, created_at, enrichment_started_at FROM leads WHERE channel='web' AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND enrichment_status='pending';
```
anya: Who can deploy? Devin can do the workflow edit, Sam can push the console rule.
devin: I'll push HubSpot rule now, and add audit property `handoff_fallback_v1`.
alice (sales): pls add note in SF when assigning to queue so AMs know it's deferred.
devin: Will do, adding `handoff_note=auto:enrich-deferred` to payload.
sam: Also let's plan a permanent fix: revert TTL to 10m for webflow synchronous path, keep 30m for batch. Add metric `enrich_latency.p95` and alert if > 12m.
anya: Can we also run a backfill script to claim leads that were dropped overnight? If so, what query?
sam: I'll run the SQL from 11:30 PST, claim to inbound-default-queue and add tag. Will post logs here when done.
hs-sync-bot: webhook_retry scheduled for payload_id=af34xyz123 in 5 minutes.
sam: Patch applied to HubSpot workflow. Monitoring for next 1 hour.
devin: HubSpot rule applied, audit property set.
sam: Backfill script started (batch id=bf_20260301_001).
anya: Thanks team. Follow up tomorrow for runbook and permanent routing design. :thumbsup:
